description: GAIA passbands include the broad-band photometric system (G, Gbp, Grp), the magnitude-dependent split blue passbands (Gbp_bright and Gbp_faint separated at G = 10.87 by Maíz Apellániz & Weiler 2018), and the Radial Velocity Spectrometer band (Grvs).
facility_description: Gaia is a European Space Agency astrometric, photometric and spectroscopic space observatory operating at the Sun-Earth L2 Lagrange point.
notes: GAIA/GAIA contains the revised Gaia DR2 photometric sensitivity curves from Maíz Apellániz & Weiler (2018, A&A 619, A180), which separated Gbp into bright (G < 10.87) and faint regimes to account for charge transfer effects, as well as the RVS transmission profile. Pre-launch and nominal bandpasses are described in Jordi et al. (2010). The owner documentation explicitly describes these as photon response functions (quantum efficiency). DetectorType is left unchanged.
